title: malcolmia lacera subsp. gracillima
intro: Malcolmia lacera subsp. gracillima, commonly known as the 'small-flowered whitlow grass', is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Malcolmia lacera subsp. gracillima include wound healing, digestive issues, and skin conditions, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments.
